assumptions.statement: Site boundary and three key area polygons are provisional (agent_inferred_from_public_data); replace with official CAD/GIS/PDF polygons before statutory use and after each polygon update, recalculate all derived layers and metrics.
assumptions.impact: All area, ratio, footprint and count metrics are valid against provisional boundary only; they must be recomputed against official polygons.

assumptions.statement: Approved regulatory controls (FAR, building height, building density, statutory green ratio, setback) are missing from the public site package; agent MUST NOT fabricate them.
assumptions.impact: Floor-area ratio, building height and statutory green ratio are listed as unknown metrics. Any control-value conclusion in proposal.md must be written as 'pending control confirmation'.

assumptions.statement: Heritage protection buffer near Qinghua Yuan station is approximated for design discussion only; official heritage protection boundary is required before any built proposal touches the area.
assumptions.impact: Heritage protection feature is marked official_constraint_pending; AI design respects the buffer but final intervention requires official clearance.

assumptions.statement: Municipal utilities (water, drainage, energy, fire, flood control) and traffic/road redlines are not available; transport and infrastructure proposals are concept-level only.
assumptions.impact: Transport, slow-traffic and municipal proposals are presented as design suggestions for professional team deepening, not as engineered or approved solutions.

assumptions.statement: Land ownership, building tenure and first-floor lease status are not in the public package; any retention / renovation / demolition / new build classification is provisional.
assumptions.impact: Retain/renovate/demolish/new-build classifications in proposal.md and compliance_matrix.json are conceptual. Final classifications require ground-truth surveys and ownership confirmation.

assumptions.statement: All AI scenarios in proposal.md follow data minimisation, public-source only, explainable and human-review principles. No personal behavioural tracking or unauthorised commercial recommendation.
assumptions.impact: Scenario cards SCN-04/05/06/08/09 in proposal.md are bounded by this assumption; visual index mirrors the same constraint.

assumptions.statement: Annual event system, developer community operation, scenario open operation, public experience route and international communication pathway are design suggestions, not government commitments.
assumptions.impact: agent.6 outputs (Switchback Day + Jingzhang Open Season) and conversion pathway proposals do not constitute confirmed government arrangements.
